title: Frame30 Universal Verification Mould (DICE) Dependency Change: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 Validator Support
objective: Authorize the isolated addition of a compliant JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validator dependency (ajv v8 or @hyperjump/json-schema) to enable authentic validation of the six DICE Draft 2020-12 schemas without downgrading schemas to Draft-07 or removing $schema headers.
merchant_or_user_outcome: Ensures that verification manifests across merchant data boundaries and formal invariants are validated against official Draft 2020-12 normative schemas with authentic validator teeth.
problem_and_evidence: Repository-pinned ajv 6.15.0 only supports Draft-07 and throws on Draft 2020-12 schemas unless $schema is stripped. Modifying package.json requires an independent, authorized feature change contract outside the Stage 2 implementation scope.
behavioral_requirements: 1. Authorizes the addition of ajv ^8.17.1 (or @hyperjump/json-schema ^1.13.0) strictly for Draft 2020-12 schema validation in development and test environments.
2. Zero modifications to existing application runtime, storefront routes, or database schemas.
3. Dependency installation must be executed independently after human contract approval.
forbidden_behaviors: 1. Modifying application code or test suites under this contract.
2. Removing $schema from schemas/dice/*.json to force compatibility with Ajv 6.
3. Executing dependency installation before explicit human contract authorization.

api: Zero modifications to existing Frame30 server RPC endpoints or HTTP routes.
database: Zero database migrations, schema alterations, or RLS policy changes.
theme_runtime: Zero alterations to theme runtime, widget renderers, or Studio catalog.
plugin_runtime: Zero alterations to plugin runtime, hook handlers, or event bus.
ast_schema: Zero changes to builder AST schemas or widget prop validation.
event_schema: Zero changes to event schemas or queue message formats.
url_slug_redirect: Zero changes to URL routing, slug resolution, or redirects.
sdk: Zero modifications to Frame30 client SDKs or public APIs.

security.tenant_boundary: Dependency installation affects only development/test build tooling outside tenant boundaries.
secrets: Zero secrets or private keys involved in dependency installation.
security.threat_model: Supply chain compromise via npm package registry; mitigated via bun.lock cryptographic hash verification.

migration.expand_contract_plan: Add devDependency via package manager after contract approval.
migration.rollback_or_forward_fix: Reverting package.json and bun.lock restores previous dependency state without data impact.

rollback_trigger: Any lockfile corruption or incompatible peer dependency resolution
